motion_snippet.GSAP Snippet: gsap.from('.grid-item', { opacity: 0, scale: 0.92, y: 16, duration: 0.4, stagger: { each: 0.06, from: 'start', grid: 'auto' }, ease: 'back.out(1.4)' });
motion_snippet.Framework Notes: grid: 'auto' lets GSAP infer rows/columns from a CSS grid layout for a natural wave stagger; Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
motion_snippet.Do: Combine with from: 'center' for a bento-grid layout to draw the eye inward first
motion_snippet.Don't: Don't use back.out on dense data tables; the overshoot reads as sloppy on informational UI
motion_snippet.Performance Notes: Group DOM writes; avoid interleaving layout reads (getBoundingClientRect) between staggered tweens
